_readme: Extra state and local bid-board feeds (RSS or Atom) for the FEMA PA scanner. Add one object per feed to `feeds`: name, url, state (two-letter), agency, and enabled. Open the feed URL first and make sure its items are bids: CivicPlus sites list their feeds at /rss.aspx, IDs vary by site, and ModID=76 is the general Pages feed, not bids. Each feed is fetched once per run; postings that do not score as PA work are dropped, so a whole agency bid board is fine to list.
